fixture: Deterministic union of smallest validation record ID in each allocation class C1 through C8 and each kmeans bank0 through4. Deduplicate then sort by record ID; labels not consulted. Between8 and13 fixture records applied to all15 prespecified selected validation checkpoints. Every kmeans bank is covered. No outcome-based method or checkpoint selection.
logical_basis: Logical |q0 q1>, logical q0 maps to Qiskit wire1, q1 to wire0. Measure wire1 into the sole classical bit. Sum statevector probabilities indices 2 and 3.
source: Exact registered source gate order, encoding1 RZ(pi*x/2), readout1 trained final RY beta, kmeans40 frozen validation route selects one depth-two bank.

transpilation.scope: Simulator basis, not an IBM hardware ISA, coupling map or calibration.

matrix_checks: Source and compiled Qiskit Operator against independent explicit matrices, phase-aligned max absolute error <=1e-10; exact Aer statevector marginal versus independent probability <=1e-10.

aer.rng: seed_simulator = first uint32 generated by NumPy SeedSequence([97003, budget, measurement_seed]); one ordered batch of all fixture circuits per budget/measurement seed.
aer.actual_simulated_measurement_shots: 15 checkpoints times number of union fixture records times (1024+4096) times5 measurement seeds
aer.stochastic_check: Familywise99% Hoeffding union bound across circuit_count times10 comparisons; record any violation, never resample or select another seed. Separate matrix/exact PASS from shot-smoke status.

full_test_binomial.rng: NumPy2.5.4 Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([training_seed, measurement_seed, budget, registered_method_index]))). Indices encoding1=6, readout1=7, kmeans40=9. Original confirmation NPZ test row order, with no sorting.
full_test_binomial.scope: Only after root release and exact evaluation. Ideal probability-level simulation, not Aer circuit execution or physical shots. 150 integer count arrays of1600 records, 614400000 represented Bernoulli trials. Five nested repeats per checkpoint, independent budget draws. Across-seed analysis n=5 nested means, not25 training replicates.

artifacts: Source and compiled QASM, checkpoint and policy hashes, exact probabilities, counts, versions, report and final commit. No provider credentials, network calls, cloud jobs or hardware.
